title: 024 沧海遗珠025 同情是个啥
content_zh:
“敢问主君，资产几何？”
樊游暗暗压下被张泱随手激起的波澜。
“资产？”
张泱现在听不得这个词。
她兜里有几个资产，游戏策划心里没点数吗？一张家园地契敢开价八十八万八千八百八十八亿联盟币，她靠着省吃俭用，日出而作日入而息，榨干每一分积蓄才凑够的。
现在哪里还有什么资产啊？
游戏策划安排这么一个试探资产的任务，难不成任务后续还需要花大钱？张泱心中咯噔了又咯噔，她被自己的念头吓到了：“我现在两袖清风，口袋空空，一分没有！”
樊游略有讶异。
他见张泱衣着普通但气质不凡，还以为她是哪家子弟。刚刚那问是想试探一下她家中底蕴，族中可有助力，没想到她开口直接承认她是穷光蛋：“主君父母可否帮扶？”
“你这个问题真让人不爽。”
PC哪里来的爹妈？
“我天生无父无母。”
人类或是其他种族还能通过两性或单性繁殖，PC咋繁殖？双方从构成身体的数据流里面截取一段，揉吧揉吧再复制粘贴出一个小PC？严格说来，游戏策划是她父母。
可张泱问候最多的就是游戏策划：“反正我没见过他们，听人（观察样本们）说，他们都是天打雷劈的主，这种父母不要也罢。”
“主君可有族人？”
“户口本就我一个，你问这些作甚？”
樊游：“……”
他也想问这位主君作甚，无父无母无家族无积蓄，张口便要统一三垣四象与诸国？
他脸上的怀疑人生过于明显，张泱理直气壮道：“这是你的问题，你就是帮人出谋划策的，我要是知道该怎么做，我能问你？”
智谋93点的人又不是她！

樊游：“……”
此时此刻，他对张泱那点愧疚也烟消云散了，取而代之的是想张泱倒大霉的念头。
这种人怎么能当主君？
他是策士，不是坐在佛龛实现信徒愿望的神佛！他要是能想出统一三垣四象与诸国的办法，他辅佐张泱作甚？他自己就去干了。
更不会沦落到眼下的局面。
樊游：“主君这是强人所难。”
张泱想了想，认识到了自己的错误：“确实，一口吃不成胖子，从第一步开始！”
说完就盯着樊游等答案，照抄。
樊游：“……”
他觉得脑子比受伤的四肢更痛。
蹙眉许久，认命般叹气：“主君贵姓？”
“张泱，字伯渊。”
“主君张姓？”樊游在脑中将熟知的几支张姓都想了一圈，“九坎一地正乱，有数支张氏被迫迁徙而无下落，主君若愿意，日后可自报家门为九坎张氏一脉旁支子弟。”
只是冒充旁支子弟不算太难。
大族人丁旺盛，旁支了又旁支的子弟多不胜数，哪怕是手握族谱的耆老都不敢确定族中有多少人，分别姓甚名谁。张泱冒充他们中的一员，也不会有人追究出身真假的。
content_en:
"May I ask my lord, how much are your assets?"
Fan You secretly suppressed the waves caused by Zhang Yang.
"Assets?"
Zhang Yang couldn't hear this word now.
How many assets does she have in her pocket? Doesn't the game planner have any idea? A land deed for her home dared to ask for 888888.8 billion alliance coins. She relied on frugality, working as the sun rose and earning as the sun came in, and squeezing out every penny of her savings to get enough.
Where are the assets now?
The game planner arranges such a task to test assets. Is it possible that the follow-up task will require a lot of money? Zhang Yang's heart thumped again and again. She was frightened by her own thoughts: "Now I have a breeze in my sleeves and an empty pocket, not a penny!"
Fan You was slightly surprised.
Seeing that Zhang Yang was dressed in ordinary clothes but had an extraordinary temperament, he thought she was from a certain family. The question she just asked was to test her family's background and see if the clan could help. Unexpectedly, she directly admitted that she was a pauper: "Can the Lord's parents help?"
"That question of yours is really annoying."
Where did PC’s parents come from?
"I was born without a father or a mother."
Humans or other races can also reproduce through bisexuality or parthenogenesis. How does PC reproduce? The two parties intercepted a section from the data stream that constituted the body, rubbed it, and then copied and pasted it into a small PC? Technically speaking, the game planners are her parents.
But the person Zhang Yang greeted the most was the game planner: "Anyway, I have never met them. I heard from people (observers) that they are all masters of thunder and lightning. It's okay for parents to not want them."
"Does the Lord have any clansmen?"
"I am the only one with the registered permanent residence. Why do you ask these questions?"
Fan You: "..."
He also wanted to ask what this lord is doing. He has no father, no mother, no family, no savings, and wants to unify the three walls, four elephants and other countries?
The doubt on his face was too obvious. Zhang Yang said confidently: "This is your problem. You are the one who helps people make suggestions. If I know what to do, can I ask you?"
She is not the one with 93 points of resourcefulness!
Fan You: "..."
At this moment, his guilt towards Zhang Yang disappeared, replaced by the thought of Zhang Yang being in bad luck.
How can such a person be the master?
He is a strategist, not a god or Buddha who sits in a shrine and fulfills the wishes of believers! If he could figure out a way to unify the Three Walls, Four Symbols and other countries, what would he do to assist Zhang Yang? He did it himself.
Let alone fall into the current situation.
Fan You: "My lord, this is something that is difficult for others to do."
Zhang Yang thought for a while and realized his mistake: "It is true that you cannot become fat by eating one bite, so start from the first step!"
After saying that, he stared at Fan You, waiting for the answer, and copied it.
Fan You: "..."
His brain hurt more than his injured limbs.
After frowning for a long time, he sighed as if he was resigned to his fate: "What is your surname, my lord?"
"Zhang Yang, courtesy name Boyuan."
"The lord's surname is Zhang?" Fan You thought about all the familiar Zhang surnames in his mind, "Jiukan is in chaos, and several branches of the Zhang family were forced to migrate without their whereabouts. If the lord is willing, he can declare his family as a descendant of the Zhang family in Jiukan in the future."
It's not too difficult to pretend to be a member of the branch.
The large clan has a prosperous population, and there are countless children who have branched off and branched off. Even the elders who hold the family tree are not sure how many people there are in the clan, and whose surnames they are. If Zhang Yang pretends to be one of them, no one will find out whether his background is true or false.
